svg.aria-label: fromAcquireAsync: from the first moment evaluations are answered by the fallback provider while a background fiber acquires the real provider, retries after a failed attempt, verifies the candidate knows a sentinel flag, and swaps it in; AcquireStatus moves from Constructing to Live, and later evaluations get real values.
svg.text: Ready at once on the fallback · real provider built in the background · then swapped in
acquire and verify are retried with constructionRetry; on terminal failure the fallback keeps serving
